assets.theme: Open Christmas Cookie Gift Box with Copy Space for Bakery Preorders
assets.palette: oat cream, baked amber, muted cranberry, kraft brown
assets.prompt:
Purpose: Create a reusable header for bakery preorder pages and holiday email campaigns, with a calm area for price, cutoff date and pickup information.
Subject and Material: Show one open unbranded kraft pastry box with six cookies held in folded parchment compartments. Use a restrained mix of star cookies and round shortbread, with browned edges, fine baked pores and modest icing accents.
Composition: Create a horizontal 16:9 layout. Position the entire box within the right 40 percent of a continuous oat cream paper surface. Reserve the left 55 percent as quiet, evenly toned copy space, with at least seven percent clearance from the outer edges.
Art Direction: Render tactile product illustration in matte gouache with clean paper edges, subtle tooth and controlled food detail.
Lighting and Mood: Use diffuse daylight and a short contact shadow tucked beneath the box.
Constraints: Output a clean 4K composition, free of lettering, logos, watermarks, brand packaging and extra props.
assets.negative_prompt: pine branch borders, café drinks, scattered ornaments, icing text, deep shadows in copy space, cropped pastry box

assets.theme: Sealed Christmas Bakery Takeaway Box for Pickup Notices
assets.palette: warm ivory, muted spruce, natural kraft, burgundy
assets.prompt:
Purpose: Create a vertical design background for bakery pickup reminders and portrait store signage with space for an address, opening hours or collection instructions.
Subject and Material: Show one closed kraft pastry carrier with a folded paper handle, a narrow spruce green paper band and one blank burgundy paper seal. Show believable scored folds and layered paper tabs, with a simple cookie star silhouette embossed on the band.
Composition: Build a vertical 9:16 image on a continuous warm ivory paper surface. Set the carrier in the lower third. Leave the upper and middle areas evenly toned for a text block and preserve clear top and bottom interface margins.
Art Direction: Use matte editorial packaging illustration with crisp folds, gentle paper grain and restrained spot color.
Lighting and Mood: Use soft side light and a compact grounded shadow.
Constraints: Deliver a clean 4K composition with no legible text, logos, watermark, branded shapes, scenery or extra props.
assets.negative_prompt: open cookie tray, café table, wreath, ornament scatter, fake label lettering, shadows crossing the text area
